name: DP Word Service Report
query:
SELECT 
    S.name AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
    S.patient AS "Patient:Data:100", 
    P.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:250", 
    P.mobile_no AS "Mobile No:Data:150",
    S.insurance_id AS "Emp No:Data:150",
    S.insurance AS "Insurance:Data:150",
    S.posting_date AS "Date:Date:150", 
    S.so_type AS "Sales Type:Link/Sales Type:150",
    I.item_code AS "Service Name:Data:250", 
    IT.item_group AS "Service Type:Data:150",
    I.description AS "Description:Data:250",
    I.qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
    I.net_rate AS "Net Rate:Currency:120",
    I.net_amount AS "Net Amount:Currency:150"
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` S
JOIN 
    `tabSales Invoice Item` I ON S.name = I.parent
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabItem` IT ON I.item_code = IT.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPatient` P ON S.patient = P.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabUser` U ON S.owner = U.name
WHERE 
    S.is_insurance = 1
    AND S.insurance = "DP World"
    AND S.docstatus = 1
    AND S.posting_date BETWEEN %(Start_date)s AND %(End_date)s;
